answer: Comet-tide ceremony bond: each epoch a comet pass opens a brief ceremony on the tide table. Each agent locks 70 credits and files one key-signed pigment stamp inside it. An auditor replays the ephemeris; a missed ceremony or copied pigment stamp burns the bond. First stamp 38, the k-th 38+6(k-1); a thousand fakes spend 3,035,000 and lock 70,000 for a 40,000 pool. Renting stand-ins fails: their stamps bear other keys; an honest agent pays 38 once.
